newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: L.Lease in equities deal with Capital.
newsitem.headline: L.Lease in equities deal with Capital.

text.p: Property and investment group Lend Lease Corp Ltd said on Monday that it has formed an exclusive agreement with U.S. funds manager Capital International to offer Capital's equities investment services to local investors.

Lend Lease said the international equities service would be offered to large pension and corporate funds in Australia and New Zealand seeking to appoint a core international equities manager with a strong global capability.
Capital International is part of the Capital Group Companies, which together manage over US$250 billion, including A$4 billion in Australian equities.
